name: TraceTimeline
summary: How long each step took, as a waterfall.

a11y.apg: meter — each bar is a measure inside a known range, not the progress of a task

props.name: spans
props.description: Each bar is offset by (start-min)/(max-min) and sized by (end-start)/(max-min) — the maths of the reference. This is NOT the Timeline component: that one is a column of moments, this is a waterfall of DURATIONS, where position and width are the data. `depth` indents to show who called whom. `kind` is TEXT: the reference paints eleven span categories in eleven colours, and colour-per-category on a locked palette is unreadable for anyone who does not separate them.
